title: Barber's symptoms compared with John Burroughs' from Rendlesham

tellings.quote: John Burroughs and Jim Penniston. John Burrows had had similar symptoms that I did and had similar issues with his VA records as I did.

plain: Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he helped carry away a UFO, says he had the same kind of health symptoms as John Burroughs. Burroughs was one of the airmen, along with Jim Penniston, involved in a reported encounter in Rendlesham Forest in Suffolk, England, in 1980. Barber says Burroughs also had trouble with his records at the VA, the US government agency that handles veterans' health care, much like his own, and he tells this as a sign that their experiences were alike.
